versions.changelog:
Initial release of academic-paper-citation:

- Automates citation management for Chinese academic papers (especially theses).
- Supports conversion between Word (.docx) and Markdown formats.
- Extracts and organizes reference lists from manuscripts.
- Intelligently inserts citation markers into the main text.
- Offers automated word count expansion to meet length requirements.
- Provides command-line scripts for each core function and a step-by-step usage flow.
